DIAGNOSIS READY: Puerperal Endometritis

Based on your symptoms of fever, uterine tenderness, and the history of prolonged labor with an 11-pound baby, you likely have puerperal endometritis. I need to confirm if you have foul-smelling lochia or painful urination to rule out other infections before we proceed.
